message: no handler for signal `V_sig` on channel "V_chan"
why: The channel is hashed at compile time, so a typo produces a hash that nothing listens on: the emit runs and does nothing, silently. A global emit matches any global slot; a channel-routed emit only matches a slot on that same channel.
fix: check the channel name, or add a handler: on V_sig from "V_chan" { … }
if another module handles it, ignore this warning.
